CONDITION_NAME_LEAF_POINTER_SHAPES extended by 4 shapes. Generated diff: record-relationships.json +74 lines only (records.json unchanged). Tests: listDelimiter builder/resolver/loader tests, per-record exact edges, whole-pack no-unresolved/indeterminate, seeded creature:ghoul one-hop discovery reaching charmed/exhaustion/poisoned.
